download_state.scope: This offline inventory; acquisition run ledger is authoritative for executed downloads.

duration.selection_rule: Prefer positive measured current-analysis duration, then explicit podcast duration, then other positive recorded duration; preserve alternatives and conflicts. Never estimate from word count.

limitations: Indexed links do not establish current availability, permission, playback, a completed download or exhaustive channel coverage.
Channel routes, account groups, publisher labels, practitioner candidates and actual speakers are distinct units.
Literal route normalization removes listing suffixes and transport/query variation only; names and undocumented numeric/handle aliases are not merged.
Explicit route/video associations retain their inherited relation type and may be weaker than a platform-verified uploader identity.
Original session catalogue rows without YouTube IDs remain catalogue records; 684 sessions is not 684 downloadable YouTube videos.
Storage estimates use hypothetical constant combined payload bitrates and known durations only, not observed encodings or a bound on all channels.

scheduling.deduplication_unit: YouTube video ID; recording/session duplicates remain unresolved
scheduling.no_total_size_claim: Full channel expansion and missing durations are unknown. These bitrate scenarios cover known indexed duration only; overhead, separate redundant encodes and future discoveries add bytes.
recommended_order: Enumerate every inherited channel route and playlist without a total-channel completeness claim
Refresh metadata and unavailable/private/deleted outcomes for unique video IDs
Save offered captions for all eligible IDs with per-ID outcomes
Download media in resumable byte-quota batches with stable IDs and one shared download archive
